Yuj chi', ix b'at heb' sk'ayb'um chi' sb'o icha ix yal chi'. Ix sb'oan heb' tas ol schi heb' t'a k'inh chi'.
Haxo t'a k'ik'b'alil, ix k'och Jesús chi' wael yet' heb' sk'ayb'um chi'.
Ayik wan swa yet' heb', ix yalani: --Wal yel swal t'ayex, ay jun t'a ko kal tik ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, xchi t'a heb'.
Ix laj och heb' ilk'olal yab'an jun chi'. Yuj chi', junjun heb' ix och ijan sk'anb'an yab' t'ay: --Mamin, ¿tom a in? xchi junjun heb' t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha jun wan swa wet' t'a jun uk'ab' ayek' t'a ko nanhal tik, a ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.

Ha in tik, Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, palta yowalil ol in chamok, icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a Slolonel Dios. Palta te chuk yik jun ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel chi'. Oktom maj uneajlaj. Tato icha chi', más wach' yiko', xchi t'a heb'.
Haxo winhaj Judas, winh ol ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel chi', ix halan t'ay: --Ach in k'ayb'umal, ¿tom a in? xchi winh. --Ha ach toni, xchi t'a winh.

Ayik wan swa yet' heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix yik'anchaanh ixim pan. Ix yak'an yuj diosal yuj ixim. Ix lajwinhej chi', ix xepanb'at ixim, ix yak'an t'a heb' sk'ayb'um. --Waanhek. Haton in niwanil tik, xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix syaman jun waso ayem yal sat uwa t'a yool. Ix yak'an yuj diosal t'a Dios yuj. Ix yak'anpax t'a heb'. --Mol uk'ejek jun tik he masanil.
Yujto haton jun tik in chik'il. Yuj in chik'il tik ol elk'och jun strato Dios heyet'ok. Ol elkan in chik'il tik, yik wach' tzijtum mach ol ak'jok lajwok smul yuj.
Palta swalkan t'ayex tiknaik to manhxa b'aj ol wuk' yal sat te' uwa, masanto t'a jun k'u ol wuk'xi heyet'ok, ayik ol wach' och ko Mam Dios Yajalil, xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi sb'itan jun b'it heb' t'a Dios, ix elta heb'. Ix b'at heb' t'a tzalan Olivo.

Hata' ix yal Jesús t'a heb': --Masanil ex tik ol ex somchajkanel wuuj t'a jun ak'wal tik. Yujto tz'ib'yajkan t'a Slolonel Dios: Ol in milcham winh tanhwum kalnel. Haxo nok' kalnel chi', ol saklemkanb'at nok', xchi.
Palta haxo yik ol in pitzwokxi, ol in b'ab'laj k'och eyuuj t'a Galilea, xchi t'a heb'.
Haxo winhaj Pedro ix halan t'ay: --Wach'chom ol somchajkanel spensar heb' t'ayach, palta a in tik, malaj b'ak'inh ol in somchajelok, xchi winh.
--Wal yel swal t'ayach, ha t'a jun ak'wal tik, ayik manto ok' nok' kaxlanh, oxel ol ik'el t'a ib'anh ol halani to manh in ojtakok, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
--Wach'chom ol in miljokcham het'ok, palta manh ol wala' to manh ach wojtakok, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'ay. Hanhejtona' icha chi' ix laj yal heb' sk'ayb'um chi' smasanil.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och Jesús yet' heb' sk'ayb'um t'a Getsemaní. Hata' ix yal t'a heb': --Kananhek t'a tik. Ol b'at in lesalwok t'a chi', xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at winhaj Pedro yet' chawanh heb' yuninal winhaj Zebedeo yet'ok. Ix och ijan Jesús skusi, ix och ilk'olal.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --Tzin te kusi, ijan wal tzin cham yuj kuselal. Kananhek t'a tik. Pitzanokab' ex wet'ok, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix snitzanb'at sb'a, ix em kuman ix emk'och snanhal sat t'a sat lu'um. Ix lesalwi icha tik: --Mamin, tato syala', ik'ek' jun yaelal tik t'a wib'anh. Palta mokab' ichok in gana a in tik, palta ichokab' wal a gana, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och t'a heb' winh oxwanh chi', palta ix yilani, waynak heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a winhaj Pedro: --¿Tom max yal pitzan ex junok hora wet'ok?
Hak'ek el he wayanh. Lesalwanhek, yik manh ol ex telwok ayik tzex montajb'at t'a chukal. Ha ko pensar, tek'an toni, palta haxo ko niwanil, malaj yip, xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi lesal, ix yalan icha tik: --Mamin, tato max yal yek' jun yaelal tik t'a wib'anh, elokab'k'och tas nab'il uuj, xchi.
Haxo ix k'ochxi junelxo, ix yilani hanheja' waynak heb' sk'ayb'um chi', yujto max techaj wayanh yuj heb'.
Yuj chi' ix kanxi heb' yuj. Ix b'at lesalwixi t'a yoxelal. Ix yalanxi icha ix yutej yalan t'a sb'ab'elal.

Haxo ix k'ochxi t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix yalan t'a heb': --¿Tom hanheja' waynak ex? ¿Tom tonhej tzeyik' eyip? Ha tiknaik, a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ix k'och yorail wak'jioch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh chuk.
K'eanhek waan, koyek, yujto lak'anxo ayek' winh ol in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool, xchi t'a heb' winh.

Wanto yalani, ix jawi winhaj Judas. Ha winh chi' niwanok ayoch stz'akub'ok heb' uxluchwanh schekab' Jesús chi'. Tzijtum anima ix k'och yet' winh. Yet'nak yespada heb' yet' te te'. Ha heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio t'a skal heb' israel chi' ix chekankot heb'.

Ha winhaj Judas chi', winh ol ak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' heb', toxo ix slajtiej sb'a winh yet' heb'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha winh ol in tz'ub'elta sti', haton winh chi' tzeyama', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Yuj chi', elanhchamel ix k'och winh t'a Jesús. Ix yalan winh t'ay: --Buenas noches, ach in k'ayb'umal, xchi winh t'ay. Ixlajwi chi', ix stz'ub'anelta sti' winh.
--Ach wamigo, k'ulej tas tzul a k'ulok chi' t'a tik, xchi t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och umnaj heb' winh t'ay. Ix syaman heb' winh. Ix stzek'an heb' winh.
Palta ay jun winh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi' ix ik'ank'eta k'een yespada. Ix stzepanel schikin jun winh schekab' winh sat sacerdote.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a winh sk'ayb'um chi': --Ak'xiem k'een espada chi' t'a yol yatut, yujto a heb' tz'ak'an owal yet' k'een espada, ol champax heb' yuj k'een.
¿Tom manh ojtakok, tato in gana tzin k'ankot t'a Dios, haton in Mam, ek'to t'a 72 mil heb' ángel ol yak'kot in skol t'a elanhchamel?
Palta tato ol in k'ankoti, manh ol elk'ochlaj tas tz'ib'yajkan t'a Slolonel Dios, yujto tz'ib'yajkani to yowalil icha tik ol in ajok, xchi Jesús.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanpax t'a heb' winh ix k'och chi': --¿Tom yajal in t'a skal heb' tz'ak'an owal yet' heb' yajal tzeyila', yuj chi' eyet' eyespada yet' he te', tzex ja in eyama'? Junjun k'u tzex in k'ayb'an t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios, palta maj in eyam ta'.
Palta icha ton tik ol aj yelk'och tas tz'ib'yajkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a Slolonel, xchi t'a heb' winh. Ix aktajkan yuj heb' sk'ayb'um chi' sch'okoj. Ix b'at heb' elelal smasanil.
Ha heb' winh ix yaman Jesús, ix yik'b'at heb' winh t'a winhaj Caifás, haton winh sat sacerdote. Hata' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio.
Haxo winhaj Pedro, najat tzak'anto sb'at winh yuj. Ix ochk'och winh t'a yamak'il spat winh sat yaj t'a heb' winh chi'. Ix em k'ojan winh yet' heb' winh polenkía, yik syilan winh tas ol ajok.
Haxo heb' winh sat sacerdote, heb' winh ichamtak winak yet' masanil heb' winh sat yajal, ix say juntzanh winak heb' winh, yik syak'och es heb' t'a yib'anh Jesús chi' yik tz'och chamel t'a yib'anh.

Manh jantakok heb' ix k'ochi. Ix yak'anoch juntzanh es heb' t'a yib'anh. Palta malaj junok heb' ix elk'och tas ix yala'. k'ojank'olal to ix k'e wan chawanhxo winak chi', ix yak'an wal och es heb' t'a yib'anh.
Ix yalan heb': --Ix kab' yalani: Ha in tik, syal in satanel stemplo Dios, haxo t'a schab'jial tzin b'oanxik'ei, xchi, xchi heb'.
Haxo winh sat sacerdote, ix k'e waan, ix yalan winh t'a Jesús: --¿Tom max ach tak'wi jab'ok? ¿Tom max ab' juntzanh syak'och heb' winh tik t'a ib'anh? xchi winh t'ay.
Haxo Jesús tz'innhej xchi. Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh t'ay: --Al t'ayonh, tato Cristo ach, tato Yuninal ach Dios. Yowalil tzal t'a sat Dios pitzan, tato yel tzala', xchi winh t'ay.

--Ha in ton tik, icha tzal chi'. Swalanpax t'ayex, a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, ol in heyila', k'ojan in em t'a swach' k'ab' Dios, haton Jun niwan spoder. Ol eyilpax wemul t'a skal asun t'a satcha'anh, xchi Jesús t'a winh.

Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh sat sacerdote chi', ix snhik'chitan spichul winh skot yowal. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' yetyajalil chi': --Ha jun winh tik sb'uchwaj winh t'a Dios. ¿Tasto tz'och testigo sko saya'? Toxo ix kab' sb'uchwaj winh.
¿Tas xe chi yuj winh tiknaik? xchi winh. --Ix och smul winh. Smoj scham winh, xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix tzub'aj sat Jesús chi' yuj heb'. Ix t'ob'jib'at sti', ay pax heb' ix tz'itanb'at sat.
Ix yalan heb' t'ay: --Ha ach niwanok tzach alnax Cristoal tik, ala' mach tzach mak'ani, xchi heb' t'ay.
Haxo winhaj Pedro, k'ojanek' winh t'a yamak'il jun pat chi'. Ix k'och jun ix criada t'a winh. --Ha ach tik, etb'eyum a b'a yet' Jesús aj Nazaret tik, xchi ix t'a winh.
Palta ix yik'el winh t'a yib'anh t'a yichanh heb' smasanil: --Ha jun tzal tik, manh wojtakoklaj, xchi winh t'a ix.
Haxo yik ix elta winhaj Pedro chi' t'a sti' spuertail amak', ix ilji winh yuj junxo ix. --Haton jun winh tik, yetb'eyum sb'a yet' Jesús aj Nazaret tik, xchi ix.
Palta ix yik'anxiel winh t'a yib'anh. Ix slokan sb'i Dios winh: --Manh wojtakoklaj jun winh tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Junanto rato chi', ix k'och heb' aytaxon ek' ta' t'a winhaj Pedro chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winh: --Wal yel, etb'eyum a b'a yet' heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús tik, yujto lajan a lolon yet' heb' skab'i, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi', ix sk'anankot yowal sk'ool Dios winh t'a yib'anh. Ix slokan sb'i Dios winh: --Ha jun winh tik, manh wojtakoklaj winh, xchi winh t'a heb'. Wan to yalan jun chi' winh, ix ok' nok' kaxlanh.

Yuj chi', ix snaankot winh tas ix yal Jesús, ayik ix yalan icha tik: Ayik mantzak ok' nok' kaxlanh, oxel ol ik'el t'a ib'anh to manh in ojtakok, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix sb'esanelta sb'a winhaj Pedro chi', ix te ok' winh sik'lab'il.
Haxo ix k'inhib'i, ix smolb'an sb'a heb' sat sacerdote smasanil yet' heb' ichamtak winak ay yopisio t'a skal heb' israel. Ix laj yalan heb' tas ol yutok heb' yak'anoch chamel t'a yib'anh Jesús.
Yuj chi', ix stzek' heb', ix yik'anb'at heb', xit' yak'anoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Poncio Pilato, haton winh gobernador.

Ha winhaj Judas, winh ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh, ayik ix yab'an winh to ix och chamel t'a yib'anh Jesús chi', ix snaan sb'a sk'ool winh. Ix b'atxi winh b'aj ay heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak, yujto ix snib'ej winh ix yak'xi meltzaj 30 plata tumin ix scha t'a heb' winh.

Yuj chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Ix och wal in mul, yujto ix wak'och Jesús chi' t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, palta malaj jab'ok smul, xchi winh. Palta ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha onh tik, malaj koch t'a a mul chi'. Ha chumxo t'a chi', xchi heb' winh.
Ha ix yab'an jun chi' winh, ix syumankan och juntzanh tumin chi' winh t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh st'unhb'ejcham sb'a.

Haxo heb' winh sat sacerdote ix sik'ank'e k'een tumin chi', ix yalan heb' winh: --Max yal-laj kak'anoch juntzanh tumin tik t'a skal k'een ofrenda, yujto ix manjicham jun winh yuj k'een, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ix laj yal-lan yab' heb' winh. Ix yalan heb' winh tas ol och k'een. Ixlajwi chi', ix smanan jun sluum jun winh tz'akum heb' winh, yik hata' smukji heb' ch'ok chonhab'il slaj chami.
Yuj chi', Slumal Chik' ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi'. Icha chi' ix sb'iejnhejkani.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan winhaj Jeremías schekab' Dios t'a peka', ayik yalannakkani: Ix yik' 30 plata tumin heb', haton stojol jantak snanak heb' aj Israel.
Ha t'a jun tumin chi' ix manjiel sluum jun winh tz'akum. Icha chi' yalnakkan Dios Kajal t'ayin, xchi.
Ayik ix k'och Jesús t'a yichanh winhaj Pilato, winh gobernador, ix sk'anb'an winh t'ay: --¿Tom a ach tik, Sreyal ach heb' israel? xchi winh t'ay. --Yel ton tzala', xchi.
Haxo heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak, ix yak'b'at heb' winh t'a yib'anh, palta maj tak'woklaj.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winhaj Pilato chi' t'ay: --¿Tom max ab' juntzanh tas syak'och heb' winh t'a ib'anh tik? xchi winh t'ay.
Palta manh wal jab'ok ix tak'wi. Yuj chi' ix te sat sk'ool winh yuj.
Ha t'a junjun ab'il t'a sk'ual k'inh, tz'ak'jielta junjun heb' preso yuj winh gobernador, hato syala', mach sk'anelta heb' anima.
Ha t'a preso chi' ayoch jun winh skuchan Barrabás. Ojtakab'il winh yuj heb' anima smasanil.
Ayik molanek' heb' chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Pilato chi' t'a heb': --¿Mach junok he gana swak'el t'a libre, am winhaj Barrabás, mato a Jesús, syal heb' Cristoal? xchi winh t'a heb'.
Icha chi' ix yal winh, yujto yojtaktaxon winh to yuj schichonk'olal heb' winh sacerdote ix ak'jioch Jesús chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winh.

k'ojanem winhaj Pilato chi' t'a sdespacho, ix k'och schekab' ix yetb'eyum winh t'ay. Ix yalanb'at ix: Manh a lokb'ej a b'a t'a winh tojol spensar chi', yujto ix in wayichej winh k'ik'i. Tzin xiwb'at yuj jun in wayich chi', xchi ix.
Palta haxo heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak ix ak'an sk'ool heb' anima, yik a winhaj Barrabás sk'anelta heb'. Haxo Jesús sk'an cham heb'.
Ix sk'anb'anxi winh gobernador chi' t'a heb': --¿Mach junok heb' chawanh tik he gana swak'elta t'a libre? xchi winh. --Ha winhaj Barrabás ko gana tzak'elta, xchi heb'.
--Palta ¿tas ol wutok Jesús, tz'aljipax Cristoal tik? xchi winh. --Kulusejk'ei, xchi heb' smasanil.
--Palta ¿tas wal junok chukal ix sk'ulej winh tzeyila'? xchi winh. Palta ix k'e umnaj heb' yalani: --Kulusejk'ei, xchi heb'.

Haxo ix yilan winhaj Pilato chi' to max yak' ganar winh skolan Jesús, tonhej ix wach' k'e somnaj heb' anima yalan yuj. Yuj chi', ix schek winh ik'jikot jab' yaal. Ix sb'ikanel sk'ab' winh t'a yichanh heb' anima chi' smasanil. Icha chi' ix yutej winh sch'oxan t'a heb' to manh lokanok winh yet' heb'. Ix yalanxi winh t'a heb': --Ha in tik malaj woch t'a schamel winh tojol spensar tik. E chumxo t'a chi', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Yuj chi', ix laj yalan heb' smasanil t'a winh: --Ochokab'kan schamel winh chi' ko mulok yet' t'a yib'anh heb' kuninal, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winh, ix ak'jielta winhaj Barrabás chi' t'a libre. Haxo Jesús ix schek mak'jok winh. Ix ak'jioch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' skulusank'ei.
Haxo heb' winh soldado yik winh yajal chi', ix yik'anb'at Jesús heb' t'a spat winh. Hata' ix yawtejkot heb' soldado heb' masanil.
Ix skichan el spichul Jesús heb' winh. Ix yak'anoch junxo pichul chakchak heb' winh t'ay.

Ix sjalan setan jun te' k'iix heb' winh. Ix yak'ank'e heb' winh t'a sjolom scoronaok, yik lajan tz'aj yilji icha junok rey snaan heb' winh. Ix yak'och jun te' aj heb' winh sk'okochok t'a swach' k'ab'. Ixlajwi chi', ix laj stz'akan em kuman sb'a heb' winh t'a yichanh. Ix laj b'uchwaj heb' winh t'ay. Ix laj stz'akan yal heb' winh t'ay: --Tzalajanh ach sreyal heb' israel, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tzub'aj yuj heb' winh. Ix tok'jiek' te' aj chi' t'ay. Ix ste pajanoch te' heb' winh t'a sjolom.
Ayik ix lajwi sb'uchwaj heb' winh t'ay, ix skichanxiel jun pichul chakchak chi' heb' winh t'ay. Ix yak'anxioch spichultaxon chi' heb' winh. Ichato chi' ix yik'anb'at heb' winh b'aj ol kulusajk'eok.
Ayik wan sb'at heb' winh yet' Jesús, ix ilchajel jun winh aj Cirene skuchan Simón yuj heb' winh. Ix ak'ji pural winh yuj heb' winh yik skuchanb'at te' skulusal Jesús chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj sk'och heb' t'a jun lugar skuch Gólgota. Ha Gólgota chi', syalelk'ochi, B'aj Ay Sb'akil Jolom.
Hata' ix yak' yal uwa heb' winh yuk'ej, kalan yaj yet' anh ixaj. Palta ayik ix yab'lani, maj schalaj yuk'ej t'a heb' winh.
Ichato chi' ix kulusajk'e Jesús chi'. Haxo heb' winh soldado chi', ix yak' suerte heb' winh, yik spojek' spichul Jesús heb' winh t'a spatik.
Ixlajwi chi', ix em k'ojan heb' stanhwan yila'.
Haxo t'a sjolom skulusal chi' ix och jun letra. Ha tz'alani tas yuj ix ak'jioch chamel t'a yib'anh. Haton Jesús tik, Sreyal heb' israel, xchi jun letra chi'.
Hanhejtona' ay chawanh heb' elk'um ix kulusajk'e yet'ok, jun t'a swach', jun t'a sk'exanh. Junjun skulusal junjun heb'.
Haxo heb' ix laj ek' ta', sb'uchwajk'e heb' t'ay.

Ix yalan heb': --Ha ach ton tik, ix ala' to tza satel stemplo Dios, haxo t'a schab'jial tza b'oanxik'e sk'exul. Kol a b'a tiknaik. Tato yel Yuninal ach Dios, emanhkot t'a te' kulus chi', xchi heb' t'ay.
Icha pax chi' heb' winh sat sacerdote, heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés, heb' winh fariseo yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak, ix laj b'uchwaj heb' winh t'ay. Ix laj yalank'e heb' winh:

--Niwanok ix kolchaj juntzanhxo heb' yuj winh, palta ina max ujilaj skolan sb'a winh tiknaik. Ha jun winh tik niwanok ko Reyal a onh israel onh tik. Ha tiknaik, yik'okab'emta sb'a winh t'a te' kulus tik kila'. Ichato chi', ol kak'anoch t'a ko k'ool.
Niwanok ix yak'och Dios winh yipok sk'ool. Yuj chi' kolwajokab' Dios chi' yet' winh kil tiknaik tato yel xajan winh yuj Dios. Inato ix yal winh to Yuninal Dios, xchi heb' winh.
Haxo heb' elk'um kulusab'ilk'e yet' chi', ix b'uchwaj pax heb' t'ay.
Haxo t'a chimk'ualil, ix k'ik'b'i t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik, masanto t'a a las tres.
Ixlajwi chi', ix awajk'e Jesús chi': --Elí, Elí, ¿lama sabactani? xchi. Syalelk'ochi: Ach in Diosal, ach in Diosal, ¿tas yuj tzin aktejkan in ch'okoj? xchi.
Ay jaywanh heb' ayek' ta', ayik ix yab'an heb' jun ix yal chi', ix yalan heb': --Ha t'a winhaj Elías, winh schekab' Dios, hata' tz'awaji, xchi heb'.
T'a jun rato chi', ix b'at lemnaj jun winh. Ix yik'ankot jun tz'ub'lab' winh, ix slab'anem winh t'a skal vinagre. Ix yak'anoch winh t'a sjolom jun te' aj, ix yak'an winh stz'ub'u'.
Palta ay juntzanhxo heb' ix halan t'a winh: --Yilxo winh, kil b'ela tato ol ja winhaj Elías chi' ul skol winh, xchi heb'.
Haxo Jesús, te chaanh ix awajk'e junelxo. Ichato chi' ix chami.

Wal t'a jun rato chi', haxo jun k'apak cortina ayoch smakulok snanhal stemplo Dios, chab'nhej ix aj snanhal k'apak snhik'chaji. Ix nhik'chajkot t'a sjolom masanto t'a yoktak. Ix ek' pax jun niwan kixkab'. Ix laj jat juntzanh niwak k'een.
Haxo juntzanhxo k'een joyb'ilel yool b'aj ayoch heb' chamnak, ay k'een ix laj jakwi. Haxo juntzanh heb' yikxo Dios chamnakxo, tzijtum heb' ix pitzwixi yet' sniwanil.

Hato yik ix pitzwixi Jesús, hato ta' ix elta heb' t'a juntzanh k'een b'aj aykanoch chi'. Ix k'och heb' t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén chi', haton jun chonhab' yiknhej Dios yaji. Tzijtum heb' anima ix laj ilan heb'.

Haxo heb' winh soldado stanhwumal Jesús yet' winh scapitanil heb', ix yab'an heb' winh yek' jun kixkab' chi'. Ix yilanpax heb' winh juntzanhxo tas ix uji. Yuj chi', ix te xiw heb' winh. Ix laj yalan heb' winh: --Ha jun winh ix cham tik, wal yel Yuninal ton Dios, xchi heb' winh.
Ay pax juntzanh heb' ix ix najattak aykoti, wan yilan heb' ix. Ha heb' ix chi', ek'nak heb' ix yet' Jesús chi' ayik ayek' t'a Galilea. Haxo skoti, skot heb' ix yet'ok yik tz'ak'ji serwil yuj heb' ix.
Ha t'a skal heb' ix, ayek' ix María aj Magdala, ix María snun winhaj Jacobo yet' winhaj José yet' pax ix snun heb' yuninal winhaj Zebedeo.
Ay jun winh b'eyum skuchan José aj chonhab' Arimatea. Sk'ayb'umpax Jesús yaj winh.
Haxo t'a yemk'ualil ix k'och winh t'a winhaj Pilato. Ix sk'ananemta sniwanil Jesús chi' winh. Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Pilato chi' to tz'ak'ji sniwanil Jesús chi' t'a winh.
Ix b'at yik'anemta winh. Ix spichanoch winh t'a jun k'apak sábana te sak.

Ay jun k'een joyb'ilxoel yool, yiktaxon winhaj José chi', mantalaj junok chamnak tz'ak'jioch t'a yool. Hata' ix yak'kanoch sniwanil Jesús chi' winh. Ix sb'alanoch jun niwan k'een winh smakulok sti', ix pax winh.
Haxo ix María aj Magdala yet' junxo ix María, ix k'och heb' ix ta', ix em k'ojan heb' ix t'a slak'anil k'een.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', sk'ual yak'an lista sb'a heb' israel, yujto k'ik'anokxo sk'ual ik'oj ip. Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix k'och heb' winh sat sacerdote yet' heb' winh fariseo t'a winhaj Pilato.
Ix yalan heb' winh: --Ach kajal, sko nakot jun winh esalwum chi', a ix yalani: Schab'jial in chami, ol in pitzwokxi, niwanok xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ma max ak' pawor t'ayonh. Tza chekb'at stanhwumal jun b'aj xit' ak'jikanoch sniwanil winh chi', masanto tz'el schab'jial chi'. Tato maay, tekan ol b'at heb' sk'ayb'um winh yelk'ejelta sniwanil chi'. Ol lajwok chi', haxo ol yalanel heb' t'a skal heb' anima: Ix pitzwixi Jesús t'a skal heb' chamnak, xcham heb'. Tato icha chi', haxo jun slajwub'alxo es más niwan ol aj t'a yichanh jun b'ab'el es ix yal chi', xchi heb' winh t'a winhaj Pilato chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Pilato chi': --Ha ex tik ay he soldado. Olxo heyila' tas ol eyutok he tanhwani, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix yik'anb'at heb' soldado heb' winh chi'. Ix stanhwan k'een heb' winh. Ix yak'och jun sello heb' winh t'a smakul k'een. Haxo heb' soldado chi', ix kan heb' t'a sti' k'een stanhwej.
Haxo ix ek'b'at sk'ual ik'oj ip, ix k'inhib'i t'a domingo, b'ab'el k'u yik semana. Ix b'at ix María aj Magdala yet' junxo ix María b'aj ix ak'jikanoch sniwanil Jesús.

Haxo yik wan sk'och heb' ix ta', ix ek' jun niwan kixkab', yujto a jun yángel Dios Kajal ix emta t'a satcha'anh. Ix k'och t'a jun k'een chi'. Ix yik'anelta k'een smakul chi'. Ix em k'ojan t'a yib'anh k'een.
Icha yek' kopnaj k'ak' yilji, te sak spichul icha k'een sakb'at.
Haxo heb' soldado, wan stanhwan k'een k'een chi', ayik ix yilan heb', ix te ib'xik'e heb' yuj xiwelal. Ix laj telwi heb', icha chamnak ix aj heb'.
Haxo jun ángel chi' ix halan t'a heb' ix: --Manh ex xiwok. Wojtak to a Jesús tzek' he saya', haton jun ix kulusajk'ei.
Manhxo ayokoch t'a tik. Toxo ix pitzwixi icha yaj yalankan t'ayex. Kotanhek, ileknab'i, ilek yet'tal b'aj ix ul yak'och heb' winh.

Ixikek, b'at alek elanhchamel t'a heb' sk'ayb'um to ix pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak. Ol b'ab'lajk'och eyuuj t'a Galilea. Hata' ol heyila'. Haton juntzanh tik tzul wal t'ayex, xchi jun ángel chi' t'a heb' ix.
T'a jun rato chi', ix yaktankan k'een b'aj mukan chi' heb' ix. Ix xiw heb' ix, palta ix te tzalajpax heb' ix. Yuj chi', ix b'at lemnaj heb' ix yal t'a heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús chi'.

Haxo yik wanto sb'ey heb' ix, ix sch'oxan sb'a Jesús t'a heb' ix. Ix k'anb'aj sk'ool heb' ix yuj. Yuj chi', ix k'och heb' ix t'a stz'ey. Ix yak'anem sb'a heb' ix t'ay. Ix syaman yok Jesús chi' heb' ix.
Ix yalan t'a heb' ix: --Manh ex xiwok. Ixikek, b'at alek t'a heb' in k'ayb'um to sb'at heb' t'a Galilea, yujto hata' ol in yil heb', xchi t'a heb' ix.
Ayik wan sb'at heb' chi', a jaywanh heb' soldado ix tanhwan k'een chi', ix b'at heb' t'a chonhab'. Ix k'och heb' t'a heb' winh sat sacerdote. Ix laj yal heb' tas ix uji.
Ixlajwi yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' winh, ix b'at yal-lan yab' heb' winh yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak ay yopisio. Ix laj yalan heb' winh to niwan tumin ol yak' heb' winh t'a heb' soldado chi'.
Yuj chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a heb' soldado chi': --Yowalil tzeyala': Ayik waynak onh t'ak'walil, a heb' sk'ayb'um xit' ik'anelta sniwanil Jesús chi', xe chi.
Tato syab' spekal jun tik winh gobernador, malaj pena. Ol onh b'at ko b'o yaj yet' winh, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ix scha juntzanh tumin chi' heb' winh soldado chi'. Ix ek' yalan heb' winh icha ix yal heb' winh chi'. Yuj chi' hanheja' tz'ab'chaj jun es chi' t'a skal heb' israel.
Haxo heb' uxluchwanh sk'ayb'um Jesús chi', ix b'at heb' t'a Galilea. Hata' ix k'och heb' t'a jun tzalan yalnakkan Jesús.
Hata' ix yil Jesús heb'. Ix laj em kumjab' heb' t'ay. Palta ay jaywanh heb' ay schab'k'olal.
Haxo Jesús, ix k'och t'a stz'ey heb'. Ix yalan t'a heb': --In ak'jioch Yajalil t'a yib'anh masanil tas ay t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Yuj chi', ixikek, k'ayb'ejek heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab', yik ol laj och heb' in k'ayb'umok. Slaj eyak' bautizar heb' t'a sb'i Dios Mamab'il yet' Dios Uninab'il, a in ton tik yet' Dios Espíritu Santo.
Tze k'ayb'ej heb', yik wach' a jantaknhej tas walnakkan t'ayex ol laj sk'anab'ajej heb'. Ab'ek, ay in ek' eyet' t'a masanil tiempo, masanto ol lajwokek' yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
